The '''Triple-Opposing Midweight Pincher''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] hand produced by the [[Brodan]] company. That type of droid manipulator was made of [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]] alloy, comprized three fingers, and was designed for grabbing and tugging objects. Due to the nature of its components, that 1.5 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] part had a med-high material durability and was not magnetic.
